TestStaticColumnQueries::test_query_stat.description: 3-node cluster (RF=3), table (k, p, s static, r1) with secondary index on regular column r1, ~10k rows in 2 partitions (s=11 / s=22). Runs SELECT {*, k,p, p, s} ... WHERE r1 <op> ... ALLOW FILTERING (5 params) and checks row count + first rows. Guards scylla #8869 (selecting a static column in an indexed query was forbidden; allowed by scylla 58a9a24ff0, 4.6).

origin.summary: Added test + CQLTester helpers in tools/testers.py, for scylla commit 58a9a24 (#8869).

Generic index paging/filtering tests; static-column index tests (index ON static col, different scenario).

TestStaticColumnQueries::test_query_stat.reason: Scenario (#8869) fully covered by cqlpy testStaticColumnsWithSecondaryIndex; dtest only adds 3 nodes + 10k rows with no distribution/paging-specific assertion; costs ~95s/run in gating (5 params x ~19s). Bug: _validate_rows (tools/testers.py:72) zips results with a 1-2 item expected list, so for count>2 only first rows are checked; assert msg swaps actual/expected. Note: 3 of 5 params use range ops (<, >, >=) on r1, which a regular SI can't serve -> pure ALLOW FILTERING, not index path; docstring says 10000 rows but data has 9999 (range(1, DATA_SIZE)).
